title: LATER
habit: Leaving the dishes for later until later never comes

short.hook: He always said "later." Then she came over.

shots.what: Opening line in italic serif on black: Later always sounds like a plan.
Wide: dim kitchen at night, ceiling lamp. Man on the couch, phone glow on his face, three plates on the counter. Orange thought: Later.
Same framing, pile of 6 plates. Orange: Later.
Same framing, pile of 11 plates. Orange: Tomorrow.
Same framing, pile of 16 plates, clock overlay 11:48 PM.
Same framing, pile of 21 plates, leaning. Orange: Later.
Phone fills the frame: messages from Mia: Coming over tonight! Can we have tea?
Daughter with pigtails and a pink bow walks in and stops at the leaning pile. White line: No clean cups? He slumps. Slow push-in.
Interstitial on black: Tired. Behind. Ashamed.
Old neighbour with cap and glasses at the open door, warm hallway light. Yellow advice: Don't wash them all. Wash one.
Man at the sink with one plate. Orange urges pile up around him: Later. Too tired. Tomorrow. Quiet white line: Just one.
foley: tap water and plate scrubbing once he starts

shots.what: Calendar: four red X's, then green checks fill in. Label: A FEW WEEKS LATER.
foley: a marker squeak on every mark

shots.what: Warm, golden kitchen, clean counter. He and his daughter hold mugs, both happy, she blushes.
End card: LATER in spaced serif caps, italic line: One plate is enough to start.
